title: MS60018: Technology Of Natural And Synthetic
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

General introduction
basic concepts and definition, rubber plantation and
production of natural rubber, chemistry of rubber and rubber additives
(compounding of rubber, chemistry of vulcanization, degradation and aging of
rubber), modification of rubber (chemical and physical), physics of rubber
(theory of rubber elasticity), adhesion and rubber reinforcement, synthetic
rubber, processing technology and manufacture of rubber products e.g. conveyor
belts, automobile tyres, hoses etc. structure property applications of rubbers,
analysis and testing of rubbers, current trends in rubber science and
technology.
